name: the-craft-of-selfteaching
description: One has no future if one couldn't teach themself.
one_liner: A free, self-paced book written as interactive notebooks that teaches complete beginners how to learn Python programming on their own, in Chinese.
buyer: Honestly, hard to find a paying buyer — it's a free book explicitly licensed as non-commercial (CC-BY-NC-ND), which forbids anyone from selling it or derivative works.
business_use_cases: A self-taught learner reads it for free to pick up programming fundamentals; there's no business transaction here.
A Chinese-language coding bootcamp could reference it as supplementary free reading, but cannot legally sell access to it or a repackaged version.
A teacher could use it as free classroom material, again without any revenue attached since the license blocks commercial use.

money_ideas.idea: None viable — the CC-BY-NC-ND license explicitly forbids commercial use of the content itself.

steal_this: There's no legitimate weekend business here — the license explicitly prohibits commercial use of the content itself.
